description: Incremental implementation tasks for Iterations 3 and 4 of sistema-veterinaria.

tasks.description: Freeze current sale, payment, clinical and connectivity behavior before Iterations 3 and 4.
tasks.reason: Protect existing Iteration 1 and 2 behavior and the current cobro visual design.
tasks.requirements: Capture reproducible baseline cases for servidor, cliente-caja and cliente-consultorio; include database seed assumptions, API responses, payment flow screenshots/checklist, and compilation commands. Work from a source snapshot and do not modify production branches.

tasks.description: Add stock control with transactional deductions, replenishments and traceability.
tasks.reason: Deliver the confirmed Iteration 3 inventory scope while preserving existing sales and catalog behavior.
tasks.requirements: Add additive schema changes for stock state and an immutable movement ledger with operator, reason, quantity, balance, timestamp and source reference. Deduct stock atomically when a sale is completed; reject insufficient stock without partial sale/payment effects. Support authorized replenishment and auditable corrections. Add server endpoints/services and caja client flows without changing the existing cobro/payment visual design. Include validation, concurrency-safe transactions, focused unit/controller tests and migration checks.

tasks.description: Implement blind cash-register opening and cuts with reconciliation by payment method.
tasks.reason: Deliver the confirmed Iteration 3 cash-control scope with server-calculated expected values.
tasks.requirements: Persist register opening, operator, opening cash, counted cash, expected cash, difference, close time and status. Calculate expected cash from persisted transactions and provide payment-method totals; the cashier submits counted values without seeing or editing expected cash before counting. Prevent duplicate/invalid closes, preserve historical operator references, expose role-authorized server APIs, and add caja workflows integrated into the existing cobro design. Add tests for exact, shortage, surplus, multiple payment methods and retry/concurrency cases.

tasks.description: Add basic employee login, role authorization and personnel administration.
tasks.reason: Provide the minimum identity and administration foundation required by the Iteration 4 scope.
tasks.requirements: Add employee/personnel persistence with unique username, adaptive password hash, role(s), audit timestamps and logical deactivation. Implement login/session behavior for both JavaFX clients, role-aware endpoint and screen access, safe validation/errors, logout/session expiration behavior, and administrative create/update/deactivate/list flows. Never expose password hashes or secrets; preserve historical operator IDs. Keep this limited to local application accounts, not SSO/MFA/public registration.

tasks.description: Provide simulated electronic invoicing traceability without a fiscal provider.
tasks.reason: Deliver Iteration 4 invoicing workflows safely without claiming fiscal certification.
tasks.requirements: For an eligible completed sale, create a deterministic local mock invoice with clearly non-fiscal status, mock identifier, request/response metadata, operator, timestamps and idempotency protection. Provide server API and caja/client presentation for create, view and status/history. Do not call PAC/SAT/provider services, use certificates, store credentials, or label output as a real CFDI. Validate inputs and authorize access; add tests for success, duplicate request, invalid sale and failure status.

tasks.description: Harden application security and externalize secrets, URLs and HTTPS preparation.
tasks.reason: Address assessment findings for local credentials, local resource/configuration access and restricted Spring configuration.
tasks.requirements: Externalize datasource credentials, JDBC/server URLs, allowed origins and transport settings through environment/profile configuration; update example documentation without committing secrets. Apply password hashing, authorization, input validation, safe error/logging behavior, secure session/cookie defaults and HTTPS-ready configuration. Review direct dependencies for high-severity CVEs and remediate compatible versions without an unapproved Java/runtime upgrade. Verify configuration works in local Docker and test profiles; document that certificates/provider deployment remain out of scope.

tasks.description: Run post-change regression, functional and three-module compilation verification.
tasks.reason: Provide approval evidence that the incremental changes did not regress existing workflows.
tasks.requirements: Replay the baseline cases and add functional checks for inventory atomicity, replenishment/traceability, blind cuts, login/roles/deactivation, personnel administration and mock CFDI. Verify cobro/payment visual and interaction preservation. Apply schema migrations to clean and current-like databases. Compile/test/package servidor, cliente-caja and cliente-consultorio with Java 21; record commands, results, known limitations and any blocker. Do not weaken or delete existing tests to obtain a pass.
